proposals.before: Learning that the Emperor had succeeded, the Empress Dowager sent his younger brother Li Hu with an army to oppose him.
proposals.after: Learning that the Emperor had succeeded, the Empress Dowager sent the imperial younger brother Li Hu with an army to oppose him.
proposals.reason: 太弟 denotes the imperial younger brother (of Taizong), not Shizong's younger brother; 'his younger brother' misattributes the kinship.

proposals.before: When the Empress Dowager heard the Emperor had succeeded, she sent his younger brother Li Hu with troops to resist him.
proposals.after: When the Empress Dowager heard the Emperor had succeeded, she sent the imperial younger brother Li Hu with troops to resist him.
proposals.reason: 太弟 is 'imperial younger brother,' not 'his younger brother' of the newly enthroned emperor.

proposals.before: He executed Minister of Agriculture Huashe and Chubuli.
proposals.after: He executed Situ Huashe and Chubuli.
proposals.reason: 司徒 is the Situ (Minister over the Masses), not Minister of Agriculture (大司農).

proposals.before: Minister of Agriculture Huashe and Chubuli were put to death.
proposals.after: Situ Huashe and Chubuli were put to death.
proposals.reason: 司徒 should not be rendered as Minister of Agriculture.

decisions.after: Learning that the Emperor had succeeded, the Empress Dowager sent Li Hu, the Imperial Younger Brother, with an army to oppose him.
decisions.reason: 太弟 is Li Hu's formal title, not kinship to the new emperor; apposition and capitalization make that distinction clear in English.

decisions.after: When the Empress Dowager heard the Emperor had succeeded, she sent Li Hu, the Imperial Younger Brother, with troops to resist him.
decisions.reason: The literal must preserve 太弟 as Li Hu's formal title without implying that he was the newly enthroned emperor's brother.

decisions.after: He executed Minister over the Masses Huashe and Chubuli.
decisions.reason: 司徒 is Minister over the Masses, not Minister of Agriculture; translating the office is clearer than leaving the title as Situ.

decisions.after: Minister over the Masses Huashe and Chubuli were put to death.
decisions.reason: 司徒 is Minister over the Masses, not Minister of Agriculture; translating the office is clearer than leaving the title as Situ.
